metadata.policy: Combat hulls from savo-island-1942.json annex rows; transports/DMS/APD from American Fleets A-42-A-47 and Rising Sun Form 10s pages 354-380. Chart anchors from chart-savo.json; unanchored screen and transport hulls use the transport area centre with the registered 500-yard spacing default.
restrictions: Henley printed as Gridley in the scenario but listed as Bagley in AF A-18; profile uses the Gridley card with the conflict retained.
Yunagi Type 96 torpedoes have no Annex F row; torpedo fit omitted rather than substituted.
DMS/APD/transport cards use the auxiliary turn table and their printed civilian damage modifiers; weapons shown are defensive AA-capable mounts only.
Tenryu/Yubari/Yunagi column interval is not printed; the global 500-yard default applies.
Yunagi Torpedo Type 96 unavailable; Type 93 candidates not substituted.
